      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.
"""

name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.

name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q "flutter-version: '3.47.x'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

      # gh-1199 AC2: the deterministic-gate boundary is self-enforcing —
      # an integration-tagged test that looks live (real provider URL, or
      # a credential-key literal with no mock/loopback in sight) without
      # the `llm` tag fails the gate. Runs on every PR: a PR adding a live
      # test (E1) is exactly the diff this must catch.

#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

{"content":"# gh-1403 rework — validation-CI red on head 5dc28fe7 fixed

## Issues/Notes

- **Validation CI went red on head `5dc28fe7`** — two failing checks, one root cause:
  - `CRAP + duplication` (guards job), step `Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)`:
    ```
    [FAIL] loc: 1/769 files over their limit
      test/release_hygiene_test.dart: 2841 lines > max 2800
    ```

- Root cause: the PR's new `gh-1403` test group (+180 lines with its two helpers) pushed `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` from 2661 to 2841 lines, over the gh-1232 god-file ceiling (`crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml`, `max_lines: 2800`, enforced whole-tree over `test/ + example/` by the guards job).
- The auto-save automation reformatted both test files with a pre-tall-style formatter mid-rework (commit `fbf142951` churned ~1853 unrelated lines); the final tree restores the canonical tall style so the file-level diff stays surgical. Nothing functional was affected at any point.

## Approach

- Reproduced the CI failure locally (RED): `dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc` → same `[FAIL] loc` on the 2841-line file.
- Fixed by **splitting by concern** — the AGENTS.md gh-1232 remedy and the established sibling-test pattern (`agent_cli_test.dart` → `agent_cli_*_test.dart`):
  - The whole `gh-1403 — IPA strip step executes its MAIN path (not just the guard)` group plus its two helpers (`runBlockOf`, `writeIpa` — used only by that group) moved verbatim to the new `test/release_ipa_strip_test.dart` (197 lines).
  - `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` returns **byte-identical to `main`** (2661 lines) — the file drops out of the PR diff entirely.
- GREEN: the loc gate now reports `[PASS] loc: 770 files within 770 limits` (exit 0), i.e. the exact CI step that failed passes.
- Regression proof for the moved tests (unchanged, re-verified): checking out `main`'s `build-mobile.yml` (without the `realpath` fix) makes the headline test fail with the exact production error (`zip error: Could not create output file (flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/fa.ipa.stripped)`); with the fix it passes. No production code changed in this rework.

## Files Modified

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.
"""

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.

name: Static gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q "flutter-version: '3.47.x'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

      # gh-1199 AC2: the deterministic-gate boundary is self-enforcing —
      # an integration-tagged test that looks live (real provider URL, or
      # a credential-key literal with no mock/loopback in sight) without
      # the `llm` tag fails the gate. Runs on every PR: a PR adding a live
      # test (E1) is exactly the diff this must catch.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.
"""

The manifest is dir/file-level. Question: is `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` listed as a FILE unit, and is `test/release_ipa_strip_test.dart` (a new loose root-level test file) covered?

From shard_files.py: the special unit `"test"` (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded to individual root-level files. And "Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest are bin-packed across the shards at runtime by file count". For file-level manifests, "the same runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE".

The manifest lists `test/release_hygiene_test.dart` as a file unit (found at line 250 within shard 1). My new file `test/release_ipa_strip_test.dart` is a loose root-level test file NOT in the manifest. Is the manifest file-level (every file a unit) or dir-level? The weights meta lists individual files (`test/a2a/a2a_client_test.dart` etc.) — looks file-level-ish. Let me check how the manifest represents units: does shard 1 contain entries that are files or dirs? And crucially — will `release_ipa_strip_test.dart` be RUN by the shards? Per the docstring: "For file-level manifests the same runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE" — a file on disk missing from the manifest gets bin-packed at runtime. Let me verify by running shard_files.py and checking whether my new file appears in some shard's expansion.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the test dirs/files of one shard from scripts/test_shards.json.

Usage:
    python3 scripts/shard_files.py <manifest> <index> [--exclude STR]...

Output: one path per line, suitable for
    dart test $(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json 0)

Directory units are printed as-is (dart test accepts directories). The
special unit "test" (loose *_test.dart files at the test root) is expanded
to the individual root-level files so that `dart test` does not run the
entire suite. File-level manifests (every *_test.dart is a unit — e.g.
packages/fa_ui, issue #283) print their units directly.

Top-level test dirs that exist on disk but are MISSING from the manifest
(a PR added one after the last weekly rebalance) are bin-packed across the
shards at runtime by file count, so new suites run this PR — not at some
future rebalance (issue #194, AC5). For file-level manifests the same
runtime bin-pack applies per uncovered FILE (issue #283, E2).
test/integration is excluded from the core shards: issue #551 gives it a
dedicated per-PR gate stage (no-key legs) plus the tag-only provider smoke.
--exclude STR
drops paths containing STR (e.g. golden — host-locked suites stay out of
the shards even when a PR adds one post-rebalance, issue #283 E4).
--exclude-tag TAG (gh-1199 AC1, tag-boundary manifests)
drops every FILE whose real (non-comment) @Tags annotation names TAG —
the deterministic-gate integration shards pass --exclude-tag llm so no
live-provider file is ever selected for the merge-blocking gate, however
it reached the manifest (rebalance inclusion or runtime bin-pack). Only
file-level manifest units are tag-checked; directory units pass through
(the dart-test invocation's --exclude-tags is the backstop there).
--tags TAG (issue #931, integration shards)
inverts the integration exclusion: only files whose @Tags annotation names
TAG are bin-packed as uncovered, so an INTEGRATION manifest (e.g.
scripts/test_integration_shards.json) auto-runs a PR's new integration
tests — and never swallows untagged core files.

Pure stdlib.
"""

project: (note) gh-1054 merge-resolution landmine RECURRED (round 2, CI-red on 770f9b34): the automation re-merges main into the PR branch on every rework cycle (and auto-save-commits + auto-pushes WIP under 'gh-1054 WIP auto-save'), so EACH round must re-verify `git diff <newest-main-tip> HEAD` for every PR-touched file and require feature-shaped additions only — round 2 (main's #862 tool-misuse breaker) reverted agent.dart (import/param/field/loop-config), agent_loop.dart (ALL breaker integration: beginRun, drainPendingNote + misuseNote payload injection, refusalFor gate in _prepareToolCall, validationRejection classification in the _executePreparedToolCall catch + outcome class, breaker observe block in _finalizeExecutedToolCall), and cli_config.dart (misuseBreaker parser/field) while main-side-only callers (bin/fah.dart, agent_cli.dart, task_executor.dart, main's tests) kept referencing them → same all-dependent-jobs-red signature. agent_loop.dart needs a SEMANTIC merge, not checkout+delta: supervision (#1054) and the breaker (#862) share the tool-execution path — the refusalFor gate must fire BEFORE supervision starts; supervision's escalations throw plain StateError so they classify as operational failures (breaker neither counts nor resets — a hung call must not poison counters); pre-threshold validation throws rethrow through supervision and still reach the validationRejection check. Recipe that worked: checkout main's file, re-apply the branch's own deltas (verify via `git diff <main-tip> -- <file>` = stuckTool-shaped lines only), except agent_loop.dart = branch version + re-apply main's #862 hunks by hand. Also: the auto-save bot may commit+push your staged fix mid-session — verify remote state before pushing (reset --hard to origin if content-identical, never force-push over the automation). [#note,#source_agent,source_agent,merge,ci,gotcha,gh-1054]

project: (note) flutter_agent_harness runs a WIP auto-save watcher that commits the working tree every ~5 min ("gh-XXXX WIP auto-save <timestamp>" commits, author AI Teammate). An abandoned mid-merge tree therefore gets AUTO-COMMITTED with literal conflict markers — this is how gh-1049's PR branch (ai/gh-1049) ended up with `<<<<<<< HEAD` markers inside test/integration/subagent_integration_test.dart, fa_cli_integration_test.dart, test/cli/tui_renderer_pty_test.dart and memory/.gitattributes (5 CI legs red: static gates parse errors, core shard, hostile-env, both PTY shards). Resolution shape: Dart files take the HEAD (PR) side; memory/.gitattributes takes origin/main's version (keeps both plural+singular merge=union drivers). Guard now in tree: test/conflict_markers_reg_test.dart (default suite) greps lib/bin/test/memory for committed markers. [#note,#source_agent,note,source_agent,git,workflow,wip-autosave,conflict-markers]

project: (note) gh-1054 rework environment: the WIP auto-save bot commits and pushes ALL working-tree changes every ~5 minutes (commit message 'gh-1054 WIP auto-save <timestamp>'), including mid-round lib changes. So mid-round `git status` can look clean while the work sits in a local auto-save commit — check `git log` before assuming edits are lost, and just keep working; the final push carries everything. Also: its merges of origin/main have repeatedly reverted one side of PR-touched files (rounds 1-2 dropped issue #862 wiring); after EVERY bot merge commit lands, re-verify `git diff origin/main HEAD` for the PR-touched files before building on them. project: (note) flutter_agent's pre-commit hook was changed to auto-format staged dart files and re-add them, blocking the commit only if files remain unformatted after formatting (previously the --set-exit-if-changed formatter gate kept failing commits). [#note,#source_agent,pre-commit,formatter]
project: (note) CI triage: the one-liner `File not formatted as yaml: .` in a failed PTY/CLI integration log is the Dart CFE's own error (it lives in the SDK's frontend_server/kernel_worker snapshots, next to "read the 'libraries.json' specification file"), not from this repo or any dependency. It appears when the JIT compile of bin/fah.dart fails to parse the SDK libraries spec on a loaded ubuntu-24.04-arm runner; the spawned CLI then prints nothing else and the PTY test's 90s waitForBoot times out. Known flake class of `PTY/CLI integration (linux, shard 0/3)`: a different victim test each run (pty_resume_equivalence boot hang, job_board_stability, scheduled_indicator — all timeout-waits), hits main's own scheduled runs too. Response per ci.yml watchdog doctrine: empty-commit retrigger / fresh validation dispatch, not a code fix. The "JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)" and "Binaries smoke gate" check runs on a PR are often 0-second synthesized mirrors of the machine-merge bot (PR #N dynamic run) — check their started/completed timestamps before treating them as independent failures. [#note,#source_agent,ci,pty,debugging,dart-sdk,flake]

Recovery recipe: restore the file to origin/main's version (if the intent is "remove the PR's additions") or re-apply edits without whole-file format. That's a new durable fact worth recording.

{"text":"flutter_agent_harness rework gotcha (gh-1403 round, 2026-10-08): the WIP auto-save bot formats staged Dart files with a PRE-tall-style formatter before committing — its commit fbf142951 reformatted ~1853 unrelated lines of test/release_hygiene_test.dart from the repo's canonical tall style (Dart 3.13 `dart format`, which CI's setup-dart stable produces and which main's files satisfy) into short style, silently bloating the PR diff even though CI itself does NOT gate on format (no `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` in ci.yml; only scripts/pre-commit self-heals, and only for agents that run it). Recovery recipe that worked: when a rework wants a test concern OUT of a god-file, checkout the file from origin/main (if the net intent is \"file returns byte-identical to main\") instead of incrementally un-deleting, rewrite any new sibling file with tall-style content, settle with `dart format`, and let the bot commit+push — never force-push over the automation. Verify the final `git diff origin/main --stat` is feature-shaped only. Also: the bot can race you between `git add` and `git commit` (\"nothing to commit\" = check `git log` — your tree is already committed/pushed; content identical means done).","tags":["#note","workflow","git","auto-save-bot","formatter","gotcha","gh-1403"]}
